runbooks.title: Reviewed documents
runbooks.notice: Find approved operating notes. Access is checked again when a document opens. Text stays inside this installation and starts no investigation.
runbooks.empty: No approved document matches this search in the current language.
runbooks.choose: Choose a result to read its current approved revision.
runbooks.manageNotice: Approval publishes exact prose to the selected audience. Review every document, then confirm with your password. A preview expires after two minutes. Replacing or revoking a corpus removes its old searchable text.
runbooks.noCorpus: No collection yet. Add its first revision below.
runbooks.format: Paste a JSON object with id, version, audience, documents and provenance. Each document needs id, locale (en or fa), title and body. Provenance needs kind (operator_authored, licensed_copy or public_domain), source attribution, license and use_reviewed: true. Use the next version; audience is administrators or all_users. Maximum 32 documents. Source text is never fetched.
runbooks.approveNotice: This exact text will be searchable by the audience shown below. Approval confirms your review; it does not prove the prose is correct.
runbooks.revokeNotice: This collection will stop being searchable. Old references will stop opening. Backup retention is separate.
runbooks.confirm: I reviewed this exact change, its audience and the recorded usage rights.
runbooks.error: Could not complete this request. Check the text and current access, then load the current catalog or start a new search.
runbooks.uncertain: The change may have been saved. Load the current catalog and check its version before preparing another preview. Do not repeat this confirmation.
runbooks.saved: Change saved. Load the catalog to inspect the new revision.
runbooks.paused: Private text cleared when this page left view. Start a new search or load the catalog.
runbooks.provenance.title: Source and usage review
runbooks.provenance.legacy: This older revision has no recorded source review. Reapprove a new revision before using it in assisted answers.
runbooks.provenance.notice: An operator recorded this review. It does not certify legal rights or factual accuracy; source text is not fetched.
